colorA.title: First neon
colorA.description: First colour of the lines and particles (cyan by default): the brand's main colour.

colorB.title: Second neon
colorB.description: Second colour of the lines and particles (magenta by default): the brand's accent. The module drifts from the first towards the second, part after part.

inkA.title: First ink
inkA.description: First colour on the light paper of the ink variant.

inkB.title: Second ink
inkB.description: Second colour on the light paper of the ink variant.

field.title: Field
field.description: Colour of the field behind the lines. A light field draws the lines in ink, as the ink variant does.

density.title: Particles
density.description: How many particles float in the field (0: none).

lines.title: Luminous lines
lines.description: Brightness of the two bundles of undulating lines (0: none).

jump.title: Leap between screens
jump.description: How far the particles stretch into streaks and speed up at each new screen (0: they keep floating).
